guidance.claim: Expecting 2,700 to 3,000 branches and INR29,000 crores to INR31,000 crores organic AUM by year-end.
guidance.quote: By year -end we foresee 2,700 to 2,800 branches, all goes well, maybe 3,000 branches and AUM of between INR29,000 crores and INR31,000 crores, all organic.
guidance.speaker: Rajeev Jain

guidance.claim: Delivering 25 to 40 basis points improvement in opex to NTI for FY '27.
guidance.quote: Overall, we are confident of delivering 25 to 40 basis points improvement for FY '27 in opex to NTI.
guidance.speaker: Rajeev Jain

guidance.claim: Digital platform will deliver INR100,000 crores next year.
guidance.quote: I am targeting that next year we should be delivering INR100,000 crores volume between customer centricity, AI and tech transformation and digital transformation
guidance.speaker: Rajeev Jain

guidance.claim: Expect to do INR11,000 crores to INR12,000 crores via AI voice and text bots this year.
guidance.quote: On disbursements, AI, voice and text bots did INR2,500 crores, we will do INR11,000 crores INR12,000 in the full year this year.
guidance.speaker: Rajeev Jain

guidance.claim: Foresee a moderation of 10-15 basis points in margins.
guidance.quote: Whatever Sandeep has guided for or what we've said, I think that moderation 10 - 15 basis points is what we foresee at this juncture, give us a quarter.
guidance.speaker: Rajeev Jain

guidance.quote: We are very clear 4% to 5% distribution expansion we'll continue to do.
guidance.speaker: Rajeev Jain

reported.claim: Profit growth was strong at 28% and ROE crossed 20%.
reported.quote: Profit growth was strong at 28% and ROE crossed 20% despite the overhang still there on account of BHFL dilution.
reported.speaker: Rajeev Jain

reported.claim: ROA came in at 4.7% and ROE at 20.4%.
reported.quote: ROA came in at 4.7% and ROE at 20.4%.
reported.speaker: Rajeev Jain

reported.claim: Opex to NTI came in at 33.4%.
reported.quote: Opex to NTI came in at 33.4%, marginally higher than last year.
reported.speaker: Rajeev Jain

reported.claim: Gold loan business sustained strong momentum and grew by 112%.
reported.quote: Gold loan business sustained its strong momentum, grew by 112%.
reported.speaker: Rajeev Jain

reported.claim: Deposit book came in at INR68,500 crores, forming 15% of the balance sheet.
reported.quote: Deposit book came in at INR68,500 crores. It's now 15% of the balance sheet.
reported.speaker: Rajeev Jain

reported.claim: GNPA and NNPA came in at 0.96% and 0.39%.
reported.quote: GNPA and NNPA came in line, 0.96% and 0.39%.
reported.speaker: Rajeev Jain
